import sys, random; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')

import networkx as nx

        for v in range(n):

    cutv=sum(c for u,v,d in G.edges(data='capacity') if S[u] and not S[v])
    f2=nx.maximum_flow_value(G,0,n-1)
    if cutv!=f:
        print('trial',trial,'n',n,'f',f,'f2',f2,'cutv',cutv)
        print('arcs',arcs)
        print('S',[i for i in range(n) if S[i]])
        break
